# dendroMixR

The goal of dendroMixR is to summarize and select mixture models via
dendrograms constructed from overfitted latent mixing measures. The
methods bridge hierarchical clustering and mixture modeling, providing
consistent selection of mixture components and interpretable
hierarchical structure discovery. Includes functions for simulation,
visualization, and applications such as single-cell RNA-seq analysis.

## Citing this work

If you find the dendroMixR package or any of the source code in this
repository useful for your work, please cite:

> Dat Do, Linh Do, Scott A. McKinley, Jonathan Terhorst, and XuanLong
> Nguyen. [Dendrogram of mixing measures: Hierarchical clustering and
> model selection for finite mixture
> models.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2403.01684) *ArXiv*, 2403.01684 (2024).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("dodat-stats/dendroMixR")
```

# Package index

## Constructing the dendrogram

Build a dendrogram of mixing measures from an (overfitted) mixture model
fit by iteratively merging its most similar atoms.

- [`dendrogram_mixing()`](https://dodat-stats.github.io/dendroMixR/reference/dendrogram_mixing.md)
  : Main function for dendrogram-based mixing

## Visualization

Plot the dendrogram of mixing measures produced by
[`dendrogram_mixing()`](https://dodat-stats.github.io/dendroMixR/reference/dendrogram_mixing.md).

- [`plot_dendrogram_mixing()`](https://dodat-stats.github.io/dendroMixR/reference/plot_dendrogram_mixing.md)
  : Plot dendrogram of mixing measures
